name: 微信文章处理到飞书多维表格

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value: =[{"role": "system", "content": "你是一个专业的文章总结助手，请将给定的文章内容总结为三句话，要求简洁明了，突出重点。"}, {"role": "user", "content": "请将以下文章总结为三句话：\n\n" + $json.content}]

parameters.name: record
parameters.value: ={"fields": {"标题": $node['处理总结结果'].json.title, "正文": $node['处理总结结果'].json.content, "链接": $node['处理总结结果'].json.url, "总结": $node['处理总结结果'].json.summary, "创建时间": $node['处理总结结果'].json.processed_at}}

parameters.responseBody: ={"success": true, "message": "文章处理完成", "title": $node['处理总结结果'].json.title, "summary": $node['处理总结结果'].json.summary}
